experiment.description: Shorts: the promise beat stays in the hook's place and moves on with one camera move, against the champion's whip to a new place (judged on held after the hook)
experiment.on: Promise beat for this Short (weekly loop, cycle 2, on): the second beat (role promise, about 5-8 s) stays in the hook's place. Copy the hook beat's last `params.place` exactly into the promise beat, give it `transition: "match"`, and move on with one continuous camera move in the same world (a push-in or a pull-back reveal from the hook's last framing), the figure landing on a thing there on its spoken word. The next beat after the promise changes place as usual.
experiment.off: Promise beat for this Short (weekly loop, cycle 2, off, the champion): the second beat (role promise) goes to a new place on a whip (`transition: "whip"`), where the figure slams onto a thing in that place, as our Shorts have done since 2026-11-13.
experiment.why: QA/fact failures 25% with the change vs 0% without
